title: UWell Caliburn GK3 Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
UWell Caliburn GK3 Pod Vape Device is a cutting-edge pod system designed for a futuristic vaping experience. The kit features the 2ml G3 Replacement Pod with an integrated mesh coil, offering mouth-to-lung satisfaction and a rich taste.
With a powerful 900mAh internal battery capable of delivering up to 25W output, this lightweight and compact device boasts a see-through case for a stylish look.
The dual airflow system and full-width LCD display on the front enhance user convenience, providing information on power, resistance, battery capacity, and puff count.
The UWell Caliburn GK3 ensures a leakproof experience, improving flavor by 150%, and includes both 0.6ohm and 0.9ohm pods for versatile vaping straight out of the box.
With a durable PCTG plastic construction, lanyard loop for portability, and Type-C charging for faster recharging, the UWell Caliburn GK3 strikes the perfect balance between style, flavor, and convenience.
The UWell Caliburn GK3 is compatible with the Caliburn G3 pods.
